implementation.lifecycle: Recheck before start/replay and each <=80-codepoint segment; 2-second in-play polling with 3-second fetch timeout; revoked access, redirected/error response, changed content hash, timeout/network failure cancels. Already heard speech cannot be revoked. Hiding the page stops locally. Browser speech implementation and installed voices require real-device acceptance.
